verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an identity provider, so the axis applies. The evidence describes Entra ID only as a Microsoft cloud service: tenants come automatically with Microsoft 365/Azure, and Domain Services is 'managed'. Provisioning users into on-premises apps is an adjacent capability, not self-hosting the core product, and nothing shows a deployable self-hosted edition.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
